description: Runtime QoS inversions (a waiting seam whose thread's QoS is above the waited-on queue's, counted per site by the blocking detector and reported by debug.blocking inversions) during trace.py's STRESS storm and each corpus story, read when each window opens and closes; sites attached. Fails on a build without CMUX_BLOCKING_CHECKS; a build without the inversions report is not-measurable, never 0.
